forms:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! The <$cdef(27)>mood at the venue is
just delightful!
<$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>And I’ve finally thought up the perfect dish to cook for
the party!

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>I knew it! You really did it! And it’s thanks to this great
<$cdef(27)>mood that I had my fabulous idea!
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,10)>The best POSSIBLE dish for this party can only be...<$cdef(27)>curry!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,10)>Why, <$cdef(27)>curry, my dear!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,9)>And it’s thanks to this great <$cdef(27)>mood that the idea finally
came to me! The main dish for this party can only be <$cdef(27)>curry!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! <$cdef(27)>Curry, you say? You sure took your time coming up
with such a run-of-the-mill answer.

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>Say what you will, but sometimes the best thing is what’s
most familiar to us!
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Just you watch—all the Pokémon in town and even the
humans <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>are sure to come flocking to the scrumptious
smell of my <$cdef(27)>curry!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Excellent! I look forward to tasting the <$cdef(27)>curry </color>you make!

<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Did you add all the ingredients to the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)> yet, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,4)>If it’s ready, please take me to it!

<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>Did you add all the ingredients to the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)> yet, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,4)>If it’s ready, please take me to it!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Did you add all the ingredients to the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1729)> yet, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>It’s been so long since I’ve made <$cdef(27)>curry—I can’t wait to
show you my skills!

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,668)><$voicel(2,9)>All right, everybody, it’s time for the party to start! The
food’s ready, so come and get it!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Goodness, <$cdef(27)>! You’re really in a
hurry
for curry!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Don’t worry—I’m making it right now with a heaping
helping of love, so wait just a little longer, pumpkin!

<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,801)><$voicel(3,9)>Looks like we’re gonna have one FIRE party, yo! And it’s
all thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,7)>I’ll play the <$cdef(27)>CDs you put in my player in the order you
added ’em.
<$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,805)><$voicel(3,9)>So, y’know, feel free to play around and find a track list
you really vibe with!

<$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,806)><$voicel(3,9)>The <$cdef(27)>mood? Yooo, just take a look around! The vibes.
Are. IMMACULATE!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! Everyone certainly seems
to
be
enjoying themselves!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>This might even convince me to become something of a
party Pokémon myself!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)>I intend to enjoy today to the fullest! Hohoh—
*rrruuummmble*
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Wha... What in the world is that?!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>A Pokémon I’ve never seen before appears to be atop
that volcano!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)> Will you go talk to them, <$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Do you think the smell of my <$cdef(27)>curry even drew THAT
Pokémon out?

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Would you go see what that Pokémon up on the volcano
has to say, <$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(8,3)><$motionoff(8,814)><$voicel(8,5)>Whoa! What’re you s’posed to be?! And what’s all that
noise down there? That you and your friends, bud?

... ... ...
<$comeff(8,10)><$facial(8,4)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,9)>Hah! You all sound like you’re havin’ a good time—and
with no humans around to help, either!

... ... ...
<$comeff(8,10)><$facial(8,4)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,9)>Hah! That sounds pretty awesome, but I think I’ll pass!
<$comeff(8,10)><$motionoff(8,801)><$voicel(8,9)>It’s cool that you’re all down there havin’ such a blast
without any humans to help out!

<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,7)>I was actually thinkin’ it’s kinda nice how quiet it’s been
without humans around...
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,9)>But y’know...a little party ruckus every now and then may
not be half bad!

<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,666)><$voicel(8,3)>Who knows? Never could bring myself to like humans.
Couldn’t care less what they’re up to.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,1)>I bet it’s their fault the world’s so messed up now!

<$comeff(8,6)><$motion(8,666)><$voicel(8,3)>Who knows? Never could bring myself to like humans.
Couldn’t care less what they’re up to.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,662)><$voicel(8,1)>I bet it’s their fault the world’s so messed up now!

<$comeff(8,4)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,3)>I mean, uh... I guess there might be good humans too,
somewhere out there.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,807)><$voicel(8,5)>They’re a tough bunch, y’know? Can’t underestimate ’em.
I’m sure they figured out a way to survive this mess.

<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,7)>Anyway, it’s been a hot minute since I’ve had my mood
lifted quite like this, bud. It’s kinda nice!
<$comeff(8,5)><$motionoff(8,804)><$voicel(8,10)>You all can consider me a friend now!

<$cdef(27)>Volcanion, the Steam Pokémon, has been registered in
your Pokédex...
Your Trainer rank increased to <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(3)>!
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,805)><$voicel(8,5)>Well, I guess it’s about time for me to get goin’.

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Oooiii, <$cdef(27)>! Were you able to
make
friends
with
that Pokémon?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Are they going to come join the party?

<$comeff(8,10)><$motion(8,801)><$voicel(8,5)>Sounds like your friends are callin’ for ya, bud.
<$comeff(8,9)><$motion(8,806)><$voicel(8,10)>I’m gonna show you all something cool real quick before I
head out. It’s somethin’ the humans left behind.
<$comeff(8,3)><$motion(8,803)><$voicel(8,8)>But first, you go back to your pals, all right?

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>That sound and the rumblin’ of the ground just now was a
VIBE, yo! Was it that Pokémon up on the mountain?

<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>I’m guessing that Pokémon likes to eat pretty substantial
servings as well. Do you think we have enough <$cdef(27)>curry?
